results.evidence: The Mountaineers give the scramble as about 6 miles round trip with 2,100 ft of gain. Powder Project measures the Heather Meadows-to-Herman Saddle approach at 1.9 miles, and a Chain Lakes trip blog gives about 5 miles out-and-back to the saddle. The waypoint mileages (saddle 3.5, summit 4.6 one way), the schedule's 3.5 miles, the partner card's 3-3.5 miles and dist_km (9.7 km = the round trip, shown as one-way) were rescaled to about 2 mi to the saddle and 3.1 mi to the summit.
